brief.en: A short sound check before going on air.

tokens.note: как вас зовут = literally "how do they call you"

sentence.en: How are you? Didn't get it.

lifeline.en: "Хорошо, спасибо" (Good, thanks) / "Плохо, я устал" (Bad, I'm tired).

tokens.note: до эфира = "until we're on air" — a broadcaster's goodbye

sentence.en: We have a connection, see you on air!

tokens.note: меня зовут = "my name is" (they call me …)
